mapping_json.fidelity_notes: FLASK-AMMO POISON LOBBER. Eras 3.16-3.19;3.20+ POST-ERRATA (verify_ledger: era claim CONTRADICTED, errata applied -- introduced 3.16.0 Scourge; corpus row is post-errata truth). ELEMENT JUDGMENT: chaos-poison kit -> s1 sends it to the poison row (earth-or-shadow); EARTH chosen -- alchemical venom register + Pathfinder nature-flask lineage (contrast b03 deaths-oath/edc: corruption-register chaos -> shadow + drain; pconc is stacking-VENOM proper -> poison ailment, earth family); shadow alternative carried here per s1 escape. Probe control listed 'wither' -- NOT mapped as a skill ailment: wither is build-external (Withering Step/totem territory, not PConc's own application) and its damage-taken-amp shape would route curse:amplify-adjacent; recorded here only (b03 probe-override precedent). ECONOMY: the flask-charge-ammo identity lands on REAL engine keys -- charge_stack=cycle + charge_max=10 (RC cap range 0..20; a life flask holds ~10ish charge-equivalents, R-M4 native-typed representative value) + recharge_source=time (Pathfinder passive regen nearest; on-kill alternative noted); the recovery-amount->damage coupling -> RESOURCE_CONVERSION door (defensive-resource stat converted to offense). PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_saturation: the kill mechanism is poison-stack DENSITY (saturation variant is the poison-stack expression; b01/b03 usage precedent, R-M1 variant-as-hint). UNARMED requirement: no engine lane for weapon-slot constraints -- flavor-noted. Hybrid damage_mode (hit+DoT) rides poison natively.
